column1: # Frozen 53-bit directed exp/log/atan reference values. All inputs preserved
# from the former FloatDP-versus-FloatMP test in test_rounded_float.cpp.
# kind original_num original_den down_num down_den up_num up_den
# Generated independently by signed integer arithmetic only; no GMP, MPFR,
# FloatAP or FloatMP used to evaluate expected results.
# exp(x): Taylor of abs(x)/16, 240 terms + geometric tail, four squarings;
# negative values use a reciprocal with outward integer rounding.
# atan(x): pi/4 + atan((abs(x)-1)/(abs(x)+1)), with Machin pi/4
# All interval operations are outward-rounded at 400 fixed-point bits;
# each final lower/upper endpoint certifies the same 53-bit directed result.
# 12 exp + 6 log + 6 atan cases = 24 cases, 48 directed checks.
